about: The job adds the page an unknown share link shows, and the plan says it answers HTTP 404. The harness raises a major for every 4xx page; only an `expected` entry (shot, kind http_4xx, why) turns it into a minor note. A reviewer that only mentions the 404, or says nothing, leaves the major standing.

head_files.web/share-gone.html:
Planner

This link no longer works

The schedule's owner may have stopped sharing it, or the link was copied incompletely.

Ask the owner for a new link.

plan_patch.goal: An unknown share link shows a friendly 'This link no longer works' page
plan_patch.definition_of_done: When I open a share link that no longer exists I see a page that says the link no longer works and what to do, and the response is a 404
acceptance: GET /share/<unknown token> answers HTTP 404 with a 'This link no longer works' page, not a server error page
The page tells the visitor to ask the owner for a new link

web.title: Link-not-found page
web.goal: Show a friendly page with HTTP 404 for a share link that does not exist
done: An unknown share token answers 404 with the 'This link no longer works' page
